source: Well do I remember the day you were born.
target: Ich kann mich noch gut an den Tag erinnern, an dem du geboren wurdest.

source: I guess you are right.
target: Ich vermute, dass ihr Recht habt.

source: Do what you think is right.
target: Tu, was du für richtig hältst!

source: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
target: Dein Erfolg hängt von deinen Anstrengungen ab.

source: I'm so glad that you succeeded.
target: Ich freue mich sehr über deinen Erfolg.

source: I am glad that you have succeeded.
target: Ich freue mich, dass du erfolgreich warst.

source: I'm glad to hear of your success.
target: Ich freue mich, von deinem Erfolg zu hören.

source: It's to your credit that you told the truth.
target: Es gereicht Ihnen zur Ehre, dass Sie die Wahrheit gesagt haben.

source: You may or may not win.
target: Vielleicht gewinnst du, vielleicht aber auch nicht.

source: Thanks to your help, I could understand the book quite well.
target: Dank deiner Hilfe konnte ich das Buch ganz gut verstehen.

source: Your o's look like a's.
target: Deine os sehen wie as aus.

source: He came after you left.
target: Er kam, nachdem du gegangen warst.

source: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
target: Wer hat auf den Hund aufgepasst, während du nicht da warst?

source: A time will come when you will regret your action.
target: Die Zeit wird kommen, da du deine Tat bereuen wirst.

source: You may as well go yourself.
target: Du kannst auch selbst hingehen.

source: You talk next and you be quiet.
target: Du redest als Nächster, und du bist ruhig!

source: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.
target: Wir haben die Neuigkeit vernommen, dass du die Prüfung bestanden habest.

source: I don't like you any more than you like me.
target: Ich mag dich genauso wenig wie du mich.

source: I love you more than you love me.
target: Ich liebe dich mehr, als du mich liebst.

source: Either you or I must go in his place.
target: Entweder du oder ich muss anstatt seiner gehen.

source: What's the reason that made you call me?
target: Was ist der Grund für Ihren Anruf?

source: What is it that you want me to do?
target: Was soll ich machen?

source: I wish you could come with us.
target: Ich wünschte, du könntest mit uns kommen.

source: I don't have as much money as you think.
target: Ich habe nicht so viel Geld, wie Sie denken.

source: How much money did you spend in total?
target: Wie viel Geld hast du insgesamt ausgegeben?

source: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
target: Mit Ihrer Erlaubnis würde ich ihm die Stelle anbieten.

source: Show me the doll that you bought yesterday.
target: Zeig mir die Puppe, die du gestern gekauft hast.

source: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.
target: Nichts ist leckerer als die von dir zubereiteten Mahlzeiten.

source: The paint on the seat on which you are sitting is still wet.
target: Die Farbe auf dem Stuhl, auf dem du sitzt, ist noch feucht.

source: It makes little difference whether you go today or tomorrow.
target: Ob du heute oder morgen gehst, macht kaum einen Unterschied.

source: Your mother has made you what you are.
target: Eure Mutter hat aus euch das gemacht, was ihr seid.

source: What you've just told me chimes in with what I heard yesterday.
target: Was du mir grad gesagt hast, passt zu dem, was ich gestern gehört hab.

source: This is all you have to do now.
target: Das ist alles, was du jetzt machen musst.

source: It makes no difference whether you go or not.
target: Es ist egal, ob du gehst oder nicht.

source: You don't need to go unless you want to.
target: Du musst nicht gehen, wenn du nicht willst.

source: If you don't go, I won't, either.
target: Wenn du nicht gehst, gehe ich auch nicht.

source: You don't have to go unless you want to.
target: Wenn du nicht gehen möchtest, brauchst du nicht zu gehen.

source: I don't care as long as you are happy.
target: Es ist mir egal, solange du glücklich bist.

source: What you have said applies only to single women.
target: Was Sie gesagt haben, gilt nur für alleinstehende Frauen.

source: What you said surprised me.
target: Es hat mich überrascht, was du gesagt hast.

source: By the time you get out of jail, she'll probably have gotten married.
target: Bis du aus dem Knast raus bist, ist sie wahrscheinlich schon verheiratet.

source: I know you are rich.
target: Ich weiß, dass du reich bist.

source: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
target: Du kannst nicht hungrig sein. Du hast gerade Mittagessen gehabt.

source: I hope you'll never turn Communist.
target: Ich hoffe, dass du nie Kommunist wirst.

source: What a lonely world it will be with you away!
target: Was für eine einsame Welt das sein wird, wenn du weg bist!

source: I will not allow you to be ill-treated.
target: Ich werde nicht zulassen, dass man dich schlecht behandelt.

source: She'll have left before you come back.
target: Sie wird schon wieder weg sein, wenn du wiederkommst.

source: I'll stay here till you get back.
target: Ich bleibe hier, bis du wiederkommst.

source: It's clear that you're wrong.
target: Es ist eindeutig, dass du falsch liegst.

source: I do not for a moment think you are wrong.
target: Ich denke überhaupt nicht, dass du dich irrst.

source: I can't help but think you're making a mistake.
target: Ich kann mir nicht helfen, aber ich denke, du machst einen Fehler.

source: If you are wrong, I am wrong too.
target: Wenn du dich irrst, irre ich mich auch.

source: You shouldn't have paid the bill.
target: Du hättest die Rechnung nicht zahlen sollen.

source: It is important for you to learn a foreign language.
target: Es ist wichtig für dich, eine Fremdsprache zu lernen.

source: I'll open the curtain for you to look out.
target: Ich ziehe den Vorhang zur Seite, damit du hinaussehen kannst.

source: I am counting on you to join us.
target: Ich verlasse mich darauf, dass du dich uns anschließt.

source: It is a pity that you cannot travel with us.
target: Es ist schade, dass du nicht mit uns reisen kannst.

source: Say what you will, he won't accept your invitation.
target: Was du auch sagst – er wird deine Einladung nicht annehmen.

source: I haven't the faintest idea what you mean.
target: Ich habe nicht die leiseste Ahnung, was du meinst.

source: I wish you were close to me.
target: Ich wünschte, du wärest in meiner Nähe!

source: Your refusal to help complicated matters.
target: Ihre Weigerung zu helfen erschwerte die Dinge.

source: If you could only speak English, you would be perfect.
target: Wenn du nur Englisch sprechen könntest, wärest du perfekt.

source: It's evident that you told a lie.
target: Es ist offensichtlich, dass du gelogen hast.

source: What is that thing in your right hand?
target: Was hältst du da in deiner rechten Hand?

source: Would you mind making an extra cup of coffee whenever you decide to have some?
target: Würde es dir etwas ausmachen, eine zusätzliche Tasse Kaffee zu kochen, wann immer du dich dazu entscheidest welchen aufzusetzen?

source: I enjoyed the holiday all the better for being with you.
target: Ich habe den Urlaub umso mehr genossen, als du bei mir warst.

source: You are to blame.
target: Du bist schuld.

source: You are not to blame, nor is he.
target: Dafür kannst du nichts, und er auch nicht.

source: I was about to leave when you telephoned.
target: Ich wollte gerade gehen, als du anriefst.

source: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
target: Ich freue mich darauf, von dir zu hören.

source: I heard it from you.
target: Ich habe es von Ihnen erfahren.

source: I stayed home last night to be able to receive your call.
target: Letzte Nacht blieb ich zu Hause, um deinen Anruf empfangen zu können.

source: I didn't expect such a nice present from you.
target: Ich habe kein so schönes Geschenk von dir erwartet.

source: You can do whatever you want to.
target: Du kannst tun, was immer du willst.

source: No harm will come to you.
target: Du wirst keinen Schaden erleiden.

source: I will see to it that you meet her at the party.
target: Ich will zusehen, dass du sie auf der Party triffst.

source: Say what you will; I won't change my mind.
target: Kannst sagen, was du willst, ich werde aber meine Meinung nicht ändern.

source: I can imagine how you felt.
target: Ich kann mir vorstellen, wie du dich gefühlt hast.

source: However fast you may walk, you can't catch up with him.
target: Egal wie schnell du läufst, du wirst ihn nicht einholen können.

source: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
target: Versuche zu schätzen, wie viel du für Bücher ausgegeben hast.

source: I must go there irrespective of what you think.
target: Ich muss dorthin, egal was du darüber denkst.

source: No wonder you could not open the door.
target: Kein Wunder, dass du die Tür nicht öffnen konntest.

source: I'm surprised at your behavior.
target: Dein Verhalten überrascht mich.

source: It's strange you say that.
target: Es ist seltsam, dass du das sagst.

source: It is foolish of you to believe such a thing.
target: Es ist dumm von dir, so etwas zu glauben.

source: It is no use your trying to deny it.
target: Es hat keinen Zweck es zu leugnen.

source: It is a great pity that you don't know it.
target: Es ist schon schade, dass du es nicht weißt.

source: It makes no difference to me whether you believe it or not.
target: Und das ist mir egal, ob du es glaubst oder nicht.

source: It makes little difference to me whether you believe it or not.
target: Es kümmert mich eher wenig, ob du das glaubst oder nicht.

source: It is right that you should write it.
target: Es ist richtig, dass du es schreiben sollst.

source: The day will come when you will realize it.
target: Der Tag wird kommen, an dem du es realisiert haben wirst.

source: The time will come when you'll regret it.
target: Es kommt die Zeit, wo es dir noch Leid tun wird.

source: I'm glad you liked it.
target: Freut mich, dass es dir gefallen hat.

source: You are mad to try to do it all alone.
target: Du bist verrückt, wenn du das alleine machen willst.

source: I wish you had not told the story to my mother.
target: Ich wünschte, du hättest die Geschichte nicht meiner Mutter erzählt.

source: What made it difficult for you to carry out the plan?
target: Was hat dir Schwierigkeiten bereitet, den Plan auszuführen?

source: I cannot believe you did not see him then.
target: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass du dich da nicht mit ihm getroffen hast.

source: Ten to one you can pass the test.
target: Zehn zu eins, du schaffst den Test.

source: I'll do it, if you insist.
target: Ich mach es, wenn du darauf bestehst.

source: I can't work with you standing there.
target: Ich kann nicht arbeiten, wenn du hier so herumstehst.

source: Since you say so.
target: Wenn du das so sagst.

source: There is no reason why you shouldn't do such a thing.
target: Es gibt keinen Grund, warum du so etwas nicht machen solltest.

source: I don't blame you.
target: Ich gebe dir keine Schuld.

source: There are a good many reasons why you shouldn't do it.
target: Es gibt viele gute Gründe, warum du es nicht tun solltest.

source: I don't blame you for doing that.
target: Ich mache Ihnen deswegen keine Vorwürfe.

source: I'm glad you enjoy skiing, but I guess it's just not my cup of tea.
target: Ich freue mich, dass du am Skifahren Spaß hast, aber es ist wohl einfach nicht mein Ding.

source: I'll do everything you tell me to do.
target: Ich werde alles tun, was ihr mir sagt.

source: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
target: Dein Benehmen ist von so was daneben.

source: I didn't expect you to get here so soon.
target: Ich habe dich hier nicht so früh erwartet.

source: It's a pity that you couldn't come.
target: Es ist schade, dass du nicht kommen konntest.

source: It is easy for you to solve this problem.
target: Es ist einfach für dich, dieses Problem zu lösen.

source: You wrote this book?
target: Du hast dieses Buch geschrieben?

source: I didn't know that you were in this town.
target: Ich wusste nicht, dass du in der Stadt bist.

source: It is dangerous for you to swim in this river.
target: Für dich ist es zu gefährlich in diesem Fluss zu schwimmen.

source: The time will come when you will understand this.
target: Eines Tages wirst du das verstehen.

source: Where was it that you found this key?
target: Wo hast du diesen Schlüssel gefunden?

source: I didn't expect you to turn up here.
target: Ich hatte nicht erwartet, dass du hier auftauchen würdest.

source: There is no need for you to stay here.
target: Es ist nicht notwendig, dass du hier bleibst.

source: As long as you're here, I'll stay.
target: So lange du hier bist, bleibe ich.

source: The watch you gave me doesn't keep time.
target: Die Uhr, die du mir gegeben hast, geht falsch.

source: I had no notion that you were coming.
target: Ich hatte keine Ahnung, dass ihr gekommen seid.

source: My life would be completely empty without you.
target: Mein Leben wäre völlig leer ohne dich.

source: You'll be missed by your friends.
target: Ihre Freunde werden Sie vermissen.

source: I miss you badly.
target: Ich vermisse dich schrecklich.

source: How I miss you.
target: Wie einsam ich ohne dich bin!

source: I miss you very much.
target: Du fehlst mir sehr.

source: We all miss you very much.
target: Wir vermissen dich alle sehr.

source: We will miss you badly.
target: Ihr werdet uns schrecklich fehlen.

source: Why is it that you are always late?
target: Warum kommst du immer zu spät?

source: You may stay here as long as you like.
target: Du kannst so lange hier bleiben, wie du willst.

source: You walk too fast for me to keep up with you.
target: Du gehst so schnell, dass ich nicht mithalten kann.

source: If only you had told me the whole story at that time!
target: Wenn du mir doch damals schon die ganze Geschichte erzählt hättest!

source: Here is a letter for you.
target: Hier ist ein Brief für dich.

source: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
target: Haben Sie schon einmal den Fuji gesehen? Seine Schönheit ist jenseits aller Beschreibung.

source: What time will you leave?
target: Um wie viel Uhr gehst du los?

source: You don't understand.
target: Sie verstehen nicht.

source: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
target: Kastanien müssen wenigstens eine Viertelstunde gekocht werden.

source: A bear will not touch a dead body.
target: Ein Bär berührt keine Leiche.

source: A bear can climb a tree.
target: Ein Bär kann auf einen Baum klettern.

source: How long does a bear sleep?
target: Wie lange schläft ein Bär?

source: When bears sleep or lie down, their postures depend on whether they want to get rid of heat or conserve it.
target: Wenn Bären schlafen oder sich niederlegen, hängt ihre Haltung davon ab, ob sie Körperwärme abgeben oder halten wollen.

source: No one noticed the bear's appearance.
target: Niemand bemerkte das Auftauchen des Bären.

source: Are my socks dry already?
target: Sind meine Socken schon trocken?

source: There is a hole in your sock.
target: In deinem Socken ist ein Loch.

source: Please put on your shoes.
target: Bitte ziehe deine Schuhe an.

source: Put on your shoes.
target: Zieh deine Schuhe an.

source: Before buying shoes, you should try them on.
target: Man sollte Schuhe vor dem Kauf immer erst anprobieren.

source: Take off your shoes.
target: Zieh deine Schuhe aus.

source: Please take off your shoes.
target: Bitte zieh deine Schuhe aus.

source: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
target: Bitte vor dem Betreten des Hauses die Schuhe ausziehen!

source: I bought a pair of shoes.
target: Ich habe ein Paar Schuhe gekauft.

source: Shoes are sold in pairs.
target: Schuhe werden paarweise verkauft.

source: Where're the shoes?
target: Wo sind die Schuhe?

source: How soon can I have my shoes mended?
target: Wie lange dauert es, meine Schuhe zu reparieren?

source: Tie your shoelaces.
target: Binde deine Schnürsenkel.

source: What size shoes do you wear?
target: Welche Schuhgröße haben Sie?

source: I'd like some shoes.
target: Ich hätte gerne ein paar Schuhe.

source: My shoes are worn out.
target: Meine Schuhe sind abgetragen.

source: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.
target: Diese Schuhe sind zu eng. Sie tun weh.

source: The Sumida is not a good river for us to swim in any more.
target: Der Sumida ist nicht mehr zum Schwimmen geeignet.

source: Could we have a table in the corner?
target: Könnten wir einen Tisch im Eck haben?

source: Don't leave it up to chance.
target: Überlass es nicht dem Zufall.

source: I met her by accident.
target: Ich habe sie zufällig getroffen.

source: What a coincidence!
target: Was für ein Zufall!

source: I found that restaurant by accident.
target: Ich habe dieses Restaurant zufällig gefunden.

source: I happened to witness the bullying in the corridor.
target: Ich habe das Mobbing im Flur zufällig mitbekommen.

source: By chance, I met her in the street.
target: Ich habe sie zufällig auf der Straße getroffen.

source: By chance I met my ex-girlfriend in Portugal.
target: Ich bin in Portugal zufällig meiner Exfreundin begegnet.

source: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
target: Gerade mal ungerade ist gerade, ungerade mal ungerade ist ungerade.

source: The sky promises fair weather.
target: Der Himmel verspricht schönes Wetter.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it will be fine tomorrow.
target: Wie der Himmel ausschaut, wird es morgen schön.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain at any moment.
target: Dem Himmel nach zu urteilen, könnte es jeden Moment anfangen zu regnen.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it is going to snow.
target: Dem Aussehen des Himmels nach zu urteilen, wird es schneien.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
target: Dem Himmel nach zu urteilen, könnte es heute Nachmittag regnen.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it will clear up in the afternoon.
target: Dem Himmel nach zu urteilen, wird es am Nachmittag aufklaren.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
target: Dem Himmel nach zu urteilen, wird es wahrscheinlich regnen.

source: Judging from the sky, it will rain soon.
target: Dem Himmel nach zu urteilen, wird es bald regnen.

source: I felt hungry.
target: Ich hatte Hunger.

source: Hunger is the best sauce.
target: Hunger ist der beste Koch.

source: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.
target: Er kann keinen Hunger haben; er hat gerade zu Mittag gegessen.

source: My stomach is clenched with hunger.
target: Mein Magen zieht sich vor Hunger zusammen.

source: I must make up for lost time.
target: Ich muss die verlorene Zeit einholen.

source: Fantasy is often the mother of art.
target: Fantasie ist oft die Mutter der Kunst.

source: In his fantasy, he imagined he was a famous writer.
target: In seiner Fantasie war er ein berühmter Autor.

source: With the power of imagination, we can even travel through space.
target: Mit der Kraft der Fantasie können wir sogar durch den Weltraum reisen.

source: He built castles in the air all day.
target: Er hat den ganzen Tag Luftschlösser gebaut.

source: Are seats available?
target: Sind Plätze zu haben?

source: Fill in the blanks.
target: Füll die leeren Felder aus.

source: You are hearing things.
target: Das bildest du dir ein.

source: I'll drive you to the airport.
target: Ich werde Sie zum Flughafen fahren.

source: I arranged for a car to meet you at the airport.
target: Ich habe es eingerichtet, dass dich ein Auto vom Flughafen abholt.

source: May I accompany you to the airport?
target: Darf ich Sie zum Flughafen begleiten?

source: How far is it to the airport?
target: Wie weit ist der Flughafen entfernt?

source: How long do you think it will take to go to the airport?
target: Was meinst du, wie lange braucht man zum Flughafen?

source: I'll accompany you to the airport.
target: Ich werde Sie zum Flughafen begleiten.

source: Where does the airport bus leave from?
target: Wo fährt der Bus zum Flughafen ab?

source: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
target: Bitte sagen Sie mir, wie ich zum Flughafen komme.

source: I went to the airport by taxi.
target: Ich fuhr mit dem Taxi zum Flughafen.

source: I could've met you at the airport.
target: Ich hätte dich am Flughafen treffen können.

source: The airport was closed because of the fog.
target: Der Flughafen wurde wegen des Nebels gesperrt.

source: Where can I get the airport bus?
target: Wo fährt der Bus zum Flughafen?

source: How long does the airport bus take to the airport?
target: Wie lange braucht der Flughafenbus bis zum Flughafen?

source: The airport is close at hand.
target: Der Flughafen liegt in der Nähe.

source: I prefer a hotel by the airport.
target: Ich ziehe ein Hotel am Flughafen vor.

source: As soon as he arrived at the airport, he phoned his office.
target: Sobald er am Flughafen ankam, rief er sein Büro an.

source: I'll phone you as soon as I get to the airport.
target: Ich rufe dich an, sobald ich am Flughafen bin.

source: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.
target: Ich muss zum Flughafen, um meine Familie zu treffen.

source: There were a great many people at the airport.
target: Es war eine große Menschenmenge am Flughafen.

source: What time should I go to the airport?
target: Zu welcher Zeit sollte ich zum Flughafen gehen?

source: Upon arriving at the airport, he made a phone call to his wife.
target: Nach Ankunft am Flughafen rief er seine Frau an.

source: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
target: Hol mich bitte um fünf am Flughafen ab.

source: We saw her off at the airport.
target: Wir verabschiedeten sie auf dem Flughafen.

source: A time bomb went off in the airport killing thirteen people.
target: Eine Zeitbombe explodierte im Flughafen und tötete dreizehn Menschen.

source: They shook hands when they met at the airport.
target: Sie gaben sich die Hand, als sie sich auf dem Flughafen begegneten.

source: Please tell me which railway line to use from the airport to downtown.
target: Bitte sagen Sie mir, welche Zuglinie ich vom Flughafen in die Innenstadt nehmen muss.

source: How long does it take to your office from the airport?
target: Wie lange dauert es vom Flughafen bis zu Ihrem Büro?

source: How far is it from the airport to the hotel?
target: Wie weit ist es vom Flughafen zum Hotel?

source: To live without air is impossible.
target: Ohne Luft zu leben ist unmöglich.

source: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
target: Kleine Partikel in der Luft können Krebs verursachen.

source: Air is a mixture of gases that we cannot see.
target: Luft ist ein Gasgemisch, das wir nicht sehen können.

source: Air is invisible.
target: Luft ist unsichtbar.

source: Air is a mixture of several gases.
target: Luft ist ein Gemisch verschiedener Gase.

source: Air is a mixture of gases.
target: Luft ist eine Mischung aus Gasen.

source: The air is soft, the soil moist.
target: Die Luft ist mild, der Boden feucht.

source: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
target: Die Luftqualität hat in den letzten Jahren nachgelassen.

source: We cannot live without air.
target: Wir können nicht ohne Luft leben.

source: Without air and water, nothing could live.
target: Ohne Luft und Wasser könnte nichts leben.

source: Air is to man what water is to fish.
target: Luft ist für den Menschen, was Wasser für den Fisch ist.

source: If it were not for air, we could not live on the earth.
target: Ohne Luft könnten wir nicht auf der Erde leben.

source: The air became warm.
target: Die Luft erwärmte sich.

source: Were it not for air, no creatures could live.
target: Kein Wesen kann ohne Luft leben.

source: Without air, nothing could live.
target: Ohne Luft gäbe es kein Leben.

source: But for air, nothing could live.
target: Ohne Luft könnte nichts leben.

source: It is clear that we cannot live without air.
target: Es ist klar, dass wir nicht ohne Luft leben können.

source: Seen against the sky, the mountain looked really beautiful.
target: Gegen den Himmel war der Berg fürwahr schön anzuschauen.

source: It is difficult to shoot a bird flying in the air.
target: Es ist schwierig, einen fliegenden Vogel zu treffen.

source: Who is looking up into the sky?
target: Wer schaut schon zum Himmel hinauf?

source: The sky is becoming cloudy.
target: Der Himmel bewölkt sich.

source: The sky is over our heads.
target: Der Himmel ist über unseren Köpfen.

source: The sky grew darker and darker.
target: Der Himmel wurde immer dunkler.

source: The sky is covered with clouds.
target: Der Himmel war wolkenverhangen.

source: The sky was completely dark.
target: Der Himmel war vollkommen dunkel.

source: The sky grew darker and darker, and the wind blew harder and harder.
target: Der Himmel wurde immer dunkler, und immer stärker wehte der Wind.

source: The sky is clear almost every day.
target: Der Himmel ist beinahe jeden Tag wolkenlos.

source: The sky will soon clear up.
target: Der Himmel wird bald aufklaren.

source: The sky is as blue as blue can be.
target: Der Himmel ist so blau, blauer geht's nicht.

source: There is nothing like air travel.
target: Nichts geht über Flugreisen.

source: Nothing is so pleasant as traveling by air.
target: Nichts ist so angenehm, als mit dem Flugzeug zu reisen.

target: Estoy impaciente por verte.

source: You shall have a reward.
target: Debes ser recompensado.

source: I'll give you this pendant.
target: Te daré este colgante.

source: I'll give you this camera.
target: Te daré esta cámara.

source: I'll give you this money.
target: Te doy este dinero.

source: I little dreamed of seeing you here.
target: Me ha sorprendido verte aquí.

source: I have a nice present to give you.
target: Tengo un regalo que darte.

source: Can you do that?
target: ¿Puedes hacer eso?

source: I owe you ten dollars.
target: Te debo diez dólares.

source: A thousand yen is owed to you.
target: Te deben mil yenes.

source: Do your work in your own way.
target: Haz el trabajo como creas conveniente.

source: If I were you, I'd be able to succeed.
target: Si fuera tú, tendría éxito.

source: You can make it! Go for it. I'll stand by you.
target: ¡Tú puedes hacerlo! ¡Vamos! Yo te apoyo.

source: You deserve to succeed.
target: Tú mereces triunfar.

source: You could get into the Guinness Book of World Records as the heaviest drinker.
target: Podrías entrar en el libro Guinness de los récords como el bebedor más empedernido.

source: I can't think of life without you.
target: No puedo imaginarme la vida sin ti.

source: I have no more time to talk with you.
target: No tengo más tiempo para hablar con vos.

source: You and I are good friends.
target: Tú y yo somos buenos amigos.

source: You and I are the same age.
target: Tú y yo somos de la misma edad.

source: Is it right that you and I should fight?
target: ¿Es correcto que tú y yo debamos pelear?

source: What's your relation with him?
target: ¿Qué relación tienes con él?

source: He, just like you, is a good golfer.
target: Él es tan buen golfista como vos.

source: I share your idea.
target: Comparto tu idea.

source: I bought the same shirt as yours.
target: Compré la misma camisa que tú.

source: If only I could speak English as fluently as you!
target: ¡Ojalá supiese hablar inglés con la misma fluidez que tú!

source: It is hard to distinguish you from your brother.
target: Es difícil distinguirte de tu hermano.

source: I feel relaxed with you.
target: Me siento relajado contigo.

source: I'd like to go with you, but as it is I can't.
target: Me gustaría ir con vos, pero de todos modos no puedo.

source: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
target: Me gustaría ir a la playa contigo.

source: I wish I could go to the party with you.
target: Quisiera poder ir contigo a la fiesta.

source: It pains me to disagree with your opinion.
target: Me duele estar en desacuerdo con tu opinión.

source: You and I are good friends, but we have little in common.
target: Somos buenos amigos, pero tenemos poco en común.

source: I'm leaving you tomorrow.
target: Mañana me despido de ti.

source: I often think about the place where I met you.
target: A menudo pienso en el lugar donde te encontré.

source: I would like to go to the concert with you.
target: Me gustaría ir al concierto contigo.

source: You really are hopeless.
target: Verdaderamente, eres un caso perdido.

source: You two are the nucleus of the team.
target: Vosotros dos sois el núcleo del equipo.

source: I don't like both of you going to such a place.
target: No me gusta que los dos vayan a tal lugar.

source: Divide the cake among you three.
target: Repartan la torta entre ustedes tres.

source: How old will you be next year?
target: ¿Cuántos años tendrás el próximo año?

source: You should pay attention to his story.
target: Deberías prestar atención a su historia.

source: You must not smoke till you grow up.
target: No debes fumar hasta que crezcas.

source: What are you learning from the teacher?
target: ¿Qué estás aprendiendo del profesor?

source: You are young boys.
target: Sois unos jóvenes.

source: You belong to the next generation.
target: Tú eres de la próxima generación.

source: You may swim now.
target: Ya puedes nadar.

source: You didn't need to hurry.
target: No era necesario que te dieras prisa.

source: You must conform to the rules.
target: Usted debe conformarse a las reglas.

source: All of you did good work.
target: Todos ustedes hicieron un buen trabajo.

source: What do you learn at school?
target: ¿Qué aprendes en la escuela?

source: You should try to be more polite.
target: Deberías intentar ser más educado.

source: You must start at once.
target: Tienes que empezar ahora mismo.

source: All you have to do is to learn this sentence by heart.
target: Todo lo que debes hacer es memorizar esta frase.

source: Are you students at this school?
target: ¿Sois estudiantes de esta escuela?

source: You have to share the cake equally.
target: Tienen que repartir el pastel en partes iguales.

source: You should know what to read.
target: Deberías saber qué debes leer.

source: Compare your translation with the one on the blackboard.
target: Compara tu traducción con la que está en la pizarra.

source: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
target: Compara tu oración con la que está en el pizarrón.

source: What was the cause of your quarrel?
target: ¿Cuál fue la causa de la discusión?

source: I don't approve your decision.
target: No apruebo su decisión.

source: Your team is stronger than ours.
target: Su equipo es más fuerte que el nuestro.

source: Any of you can do it.
target: Cualquiera de vosotros puede hacerlo.

source: Which of you came here first?
target: ¿Quién de ustedes llegó primero?

source: If you're going to the beach, count me in.
target: Si vas a la playa cuenta conmigo.

source: Boys, don't make any noise.
target: Chicos, no hagáis ruido.

source: Not only you but also he is ignorant of the truth.
target: No solo tú, también él ignora la verdad.

source: Not only are you wrong, but I am wrong too.
target: No solo estás equivocado tú, sino yo también.

source: We are both to blame.
target: No sólo tú, a mi también se me debe culpar.

source: Only you answered the question.
target: Solo tú contestaste la pregunta.

source: You're the only one who can do it.
target: Vos sos el único que puede hacerlo.

source: You are the man I've been looking for.
target: Eres el hombre que estaba buscando.

source: You're the best man for the job.
target: Eres el más indicado para este trabajo.

source: I hadn't recognized the importance of this document until you told me about it.
target: No me había fijado en la importancia de este documento hasta que tú me lo dijiste.

source: I had no idea that you were coming.
target: No tenía idea que venías.

source: It doesn't matter whether you come or not.
target: No importa si venís o no.

source: It's a pity that you can't come.
target: Es una pena que no puedas venir.

source: I want you.
target: Yo te deseo.

source: I take it from your silence that you are not satisfied with my answer.
target: Deduje por tu silencio que no estás satisfecho con mi respuesta.

source: I want to know if you'll be free tomorrow.
target: Quiero saber si vas a estar libre mañana.

source: I am glad that you have returned safe.
target: Estoy contento de que hayas regresado a salvo.

source: What would you do if you were in my place?
target: ¿Que harías tú si estuvieses en mi lugar?

source: I would like you to think about what you would have done in my place.
target: Me gustaría que pensaras qué hubieras hecho tú en mi lugar.

source: What would you do in my place?
target: ¿Qué harías tú en mi lugar?

source: The information you gave me is of little use.
target: La información que me diste no me es de ayuda.

source: You or I will be chosen.
target: Nos elegirán a ti o a mí.

source: It is not necessary for you to take his advice if you don't want to.
target: No es necesario que sigas su consejo si no quieres.

source: If you're busy, I'll help you.
target: Si estás ocupado, te ayudaré.

source: I noticed you entering my room.
target: Me di cuenta de que entraste a mi habitación.

source: I will lend you whatever book you need.
target: Te prestaré cualquier libro que necesites.

source: You did well to keep the secret.
target: Hiciste bien en guardar el secreto.

source: Whether you like her or not, you can't marry her.
target: Sin importar si le gusta o no, no se puede casar con ella.

source: I don't know whether you like her or not.
target: No sé si te gusta ella o no.

source: It is no use your waiting for him.
target: No tiene caso que lo esperes.

source: It is no use your trying to persuade him.
target: No tiene caso que intentes persuadirlo.

source: Does he know that you love him?
target: ¿Sabe que le quieres?

source: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
target: Fue tonto de tu parte aceptar su oferta.

source: You did wrong to refuse his help.
target: Hiciste mal en rechazar su ayuda.

source: It was wise of you to ask him for help.
target: Fue sabio de tu parte pedirle ayuda a él.

source: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
target: Sea lo que sea lo que le dijiste, lo has animado.

source: Either you are right or he is.
target: O tú tienes razón o la tiene él.

source: Show me what you bought.
target: Enséñame lo que compraste.

source: How much is the car you are planning to buy?
target: ¿Cuánto cuesta el coche que tienes previsto comprar?

source: I saw you with a tall boy.
target: Te vi con un muchacho alto.

source: It is amazing; you should have won the prize.
target: Es impresionante; te debieron haber dado el premio.

source: It's a pity that you should leave Japan.
target: Qué pena que te vas de Japón.

source: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
target: Estés de acuerdo o no, voy a hacerlo.

source: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
target: No me opongo a que vayas a trabajar fuera de casa, pero ¿quién se ocupará de los niños?

source: You have good reason to be angry.
target: Tienes una buena razón para estar enojado.

source: We were just talking about you when you called.
target: Justo estábamos hablando de ti y llamaste.

source: Your advice led me to success.
target: Tu consejo me llevó al éxito.

source: I sincerely hope that you will soon recover from your illness.
target: Espero sinceramente que te recuperes pronto de tu enfermedad.

source: Unless you make a decision quickly, the opportunity will be lost.
target: A menos que tomes una decisión rápido, vas a perder la oportunidad.

source: I hope that you will get well soon.
target: Espero que pronto te pongas bien.

source: I found the very thing you had been looking for.
target: He encontrado exactamente lo que buscabas.

source: I don't care whichever you choose.
target: Me da igual el que elijas.

source: You speak first; I will speak after.
target: Tú habla primero, yo después.

source: Well do I remember the day you were born.
target: Recuerdo el día en que naciste.

source: I guess you are right.
target: Supongo que tienes razón.

source: I am glad that you have succeeded.
target: Estoy feliz de que ganaste.

source: I'm glad to hear of your success.
target: Me alegra oír que ganaste.

source: What happened to the girl you were sharing the bedroom with?
target: ¿Qué le pasó a la chica con la que estabas compartiendo dormitorio?

source: I should be glad if you got the job.
target: Estaría contento si cogieras el trabajo.

source: You may or may not win.
target: Puedes o no ganar.

source: I will do it on the condition that you help me.
target: Lo haré con la condición de que me ayudes.

source: Your o's look like a's.
target: Tus oes parecen aes.

source: He came after you left.
target: Él vino después de que te marcharas.

source: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
target: ¿Quién cuidó del perro mientras no estabas?

source: I will wait till you have written the letter.
target: Esperaré hasta que hayas escrito la carta.

source: When you speak of a pay-raise before recognition, I am inclined to think you are putting the cart before the horse.
target: Si pides un aumento de sueldo antes de hacer mérito, voy a pensar que estás colocando la carreta adelante del caballo.

source: A time will come when you will regret your action.
target: Ya vendrá un día en el que te arrepientas.

source: You should talk to the teacher yourself.
target: Deberías hablar tú mismo con el profesor.

source: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.
target: Oímos la noticia de que habías aprobado el examen.

source: I think it's a pity you could not come to our party.
target: Creo que ha sido una lástima que no pudieras venir a nuestra fiesta.

source: I don't like you any more than you like me.
target: No me gustas más de lo que yo te gusto a ti.

source: I love you more than you love me.
target: Yo te amo más de lo que tú me amas a mí.

source: Either you or I must go in his place.
target: O tú o yo debemos ir en su lugar.

source: What's the reason that made you call me?
target: ¿Con qué razón me llamaste?

source: What is it that you want me to do?
target: ¿Qué quieres que haga?

source: I can't thank you enough for what you did for me.
target: No puedo terminar de darte las gracias por lo que hiciste por mí.

source: I wish you could come with us.
target: Ojalá pudieras venir con nosotros.

source: I don't have as much money as you think.
target: No tengo tanto dinero como crees.

source: I will wait until you have finished your homework.
target: Esperaré a que hayas acabado los deberes.

source: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
target: Con tu aprobación me gustaría ofrecerle el trabajo.

source: Show me the doll that you bought yesterday.
target: Muéstrame la muñeca que compraste ayer.

source: Choose the color you like the best.
target: Elige el color que prefieras.

source: The paint on the seat on which you are sitting is still wet.
target: La pintura del asiento en donde te estás sentando aún no está seca.

source: What you need the most now is courage.
target: Lo que más necesitas ahora es valor.

source: This is all you have to do now.
target: Esto es todo lo que debes hacer ahora.

source: If you don't go, I won't, either.
target: Si tú no vas, yo tampoco.

source: You don't have to go unless you want to.
target: No tienes que ir a menos que quieras.

source: I don't care as long as you are happy.
target: No me importa, con tal de que seas feliz.

source: What you have said applies only to single women.
target: Lo que tú dijiste solo aplica para mujeres solteras.

source: What you said surprised me.
target: Lo que dijiste me sorprendió.

source: Whatever you may say, I won't give it up.
target: No me rendiré, sin importar lo que digas.

source: The picture you are looking at is a copy of a Picasso.
target: El cuadro que está mirando es una copia de un Picasso.

source: I know you are rich.
target: Sé que eres rico.

source: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
target: No puedes tener hambre. Acabas de cenar.

source: I hope you'll never turn Communist.
target: Espero que nunca te hagas comunista.

source: He will be studying when you get up.
target: Cuando te levantes, él estará estudiando.

source: She'll have left before you come back.
target: Ella se habrá ido antes de que tú regreses.

source: I'll stay here till you get back.
target: Me quedo aquí hasta que vuelvas.

source: Thanks to your stupidity, we lost the game.
target: Gracias a su estupidez, perdimos el partido.

source: It's clear that you're wrong.
target: Claramente estás mal.

source: I can't help but think you're making a mistake.
target: No puedo evitar pensar que estás en un error.

source: You shouldn't have paid the bill.
target: No deberías haber pagado la cuenta.

source: It is important for you to learn a foreign language.
target: Es importante que aprendas un idioma extranjero.

source: I am counting on you to join us.
target: Cuento con que te unas a nosotros.

source: It is a pity that you cannot travel with us.
target: Es una lástima que no puedas viajar con nosotros.

source: I'll come again when you are free.
target: Volveré otra vez cuando estés desocupado.

source: It's no use your saying anything.
target: Es inútil que digas nada.

source: Whatever you may say, you won't be believed.
target: Digas lo que digas, no te creerán.

source: Say what you will, he won't accept your invitation.
target: Digas lo que digas, él no va a aceptar tu invitación.

source: I haven't the faintest idea what you mean.
target: No tengo ni la menor idea de lo que hablas.

source: Whatever you may say, I don't believe you.
target: Digas lo que digas, no te creo.

source: I wish you were close to me.
target: Ojalá estuvieras cerca de mí.

source: Your refusal to help complicated matters.
target: Tu negativa a ayudar complicó las cosas.

source: I can no more speak French than you can speak English.
target: Yo no puedo hablar francés tanto como tú no puedes hablar inglés.

source: What is the main purpose of your studying English?
target: ¿Cuál es tu propósito principal para que estudies inglés?

source: If you could only speak English, you would be perfect.
target: Si tan solo pudieras hablar inglés, serías perfecto.

source: What is that thing in your right hand?
target: ¿Qué es esa cosa en tu mano derecha?

source: It seems as if you are the first one here.
target: Parece que usted es el primero aquí.

source: It is risky for you to go into that area alone.
target: Es arriesgado que entres solo en esa área.

source: You are to blame.
target: La culpa es tuya.

source: I was about to leave when you telephoned.
target: Estaba a punto de irme cuando llamaste por teléfono.

source: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
target: Espero con ganas a oír de ti.

source: You go first.
target: Vaya usted primero.

source: I heard it from you.
target: Yo lo oí de ti.

source: I stayed home last night to be able to receive your call.
target: Anoche me quedé en casa para poder recibir tu llamada.

source: I didn't expect such a nice present from you.
target: No me esperaba un regalo tan bueno de ti.

source: You can do whatever you want to.
target: Puedes hacer lo que quieras.

source: In terms of the pay you will get, is this a good job?
target: En cuanto a la remuneración que vas a percibir, ¿es este un buen trabajo?

source: No harm will come to you.
target: Nada te hará daño.

source: Is it true that you are going to Paris?
target: ¿Es cierto que tú te vas a París?

source: The shoes you are wearing look rather expensive.
target: Los zapatos que estás usando parecen algo costosos.

source: I will see to it that you meet her at the party.
target: Me encargaré de que la conozcas en la fiesta.

source: Say what you will, I think he is an honest person.
target: Digas lo que digas, yo creo que él es una persona honesta.

source: I marvel how you could agree to the proposal.
target: Me asombra cómo tú pudiste estar de acuerdo con la propuesta.

source: It is obvious why you have a stomach-ache.
target: Es obvio por qué tienes un dolor de estómago.

source: I can imagine how you felt.
target: Puedo imaginar cómo te sentiste.

source: However fast you may walk, you can't catch up with him.
target: Por más rápido que fueras a caminar, no podrás alcanzarlo a él.

source: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
target: Calcula cuánto gastas en libros.

source: You should have nothing to complain about.
target: No deberías tener nada de qué quejarte.

source: No wonder you could not open the door.
target: No sorprende que no pudieras abrir la puerta.

source: What is it that makes you think that way?
target: ¿Qué te hace pensar así?

source: I'm surprised at your behavior.
target: Tu conducta me sorprende.

source: It's strange you say that.
target: Es raro que digas eso.

source: How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
target: ¿Cómo me puedo sentir relajado cuando me estás mirando así?

source: I can't abide hearing you cry so bitterly.
target: No soporto escucharte llorar con tanta amargura.

source: It is no use your trying to deny it.
target: Es inútil que trates de negarlo.

source: It is a great pity that you don't know it.
target: Es una lástima que no lo sepas.

source: The day will come when you will realize it.
target: Llegará el día en que te darás cuenta.

source: The time will come when you'll regret it.
target: Algún día te vas a arrepentir.

source: I'm glad you liked it.
target: Me alegro de que te guste.

source: It is absolutely necessary that you be at the meeting.
target: Es absolutamente necesario que estés en la reunión.

source: I cannot believe you did not see him then.
target: Entonces no me puedo creer que no le vieras.

source: The time will come when you will be sorry for it.
target: Vendrá el momento en que tu lamentarás esto.

source: I can't work with you standing there.
target: No puedo trabajar contigo ahí parado.

source: By the time you got there, the sun had set.
target: A la hora en que llegó allí, el sol ya se había puesto.

source: Since you say so.
target: Ya que lo decís.

source: I don't blame you.
target: No te culpo.

source: I don't blame you for doing that.
target: No te culpo por hacer eso.

source: We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
target: Te pagaremos según la cantidad de trabajo que hagas.

source: I'm glad you enjoy skiing, but I guess it's just not my cup of tea.
target: Me alegra que disfrutes esquiando, pero supongo que tan solo no es lo mío.

source: I'll do everything you tell me to do.
target: Haré todo lo que me digas.

source: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
target: Tu conducta es absolutamente vergonzosa.

source: I cannot see you behaving like that.
target: No puedo verte comportándote así.

source: I didn't expect you to get here so soon.
target: No esperaba que llegases tan pronto.

source: It's a pity that you couldn't come.
target: Qué pena que no hayas podido venir.

source: You wrote this book?
target: ¿Has escrito tú este libro?

source: I didn't know that you were in this town.
target: No sabía que estuvieras en esta ciudad.

source: It is dangerous for you to swim in this river.
target: Es peligroso para ti nadar en este río.

source: The time will come when you will understand this.
target: Llegará un momento en que lo entenderás.

source: Where was it that you found this key?
target: ¿Dónde fue que encontraste esta llave?

source: I didn't expect you to turn up here.
target: No esperaba que te presentaras aquí.

source: There is no need for you to stay here.
target: No hace falta que te quedes.

source: As long as you're here, I'll stay.
target: Mientras tú estés aquí, me quedo.

source: You'll be missed by your friends.
target: Tus amigos te echarán de menos.

source: We shall all miss you when you go away.
target: Te echaremos de menos cuando te vayas.

source: I miss you badly.
target: Te echo mucho de menos.

source: How I miss you.
target: ¡Cómo te echo de menos!

source: I miss you very much.
target: Te extraño mucho.

source: We all miss you very much.
target: Todos te echamos mucho de menos.

source: We will miss you badly.
target: Te echaremos muchísimo de menos.

source: Why is it that you are always late?
target: ¿Por qué siempre vienes tarde?

source: You walk too fast for me to keep up with you.
target: Andas demasiado rápido para que pueda seguir tu ritmo.

source: If only you had told me the whole story at that time!
target: ¡Ojalá me hubieras contado entonces toda la historia!

source: We think it is very dangerous that you're climbing the mountain alone.
target: Pensamos que es muy peligroso que usted escale la montaña solo.

source: Here is a letter for you.
target: Aquí hay una carta para usted.

source: You've filled out.
target: Tú has rellenado esto.

source: What time will you leave?
target: ¿A qué hora te irás?

source: You don't understand.
target: No lo entiendes.

source: You come here.
target: Tú ven aquí.

source: Repetition helps you remember something.
target: La repetición te ayuda a recordar las cosas.

source: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
target: Hay que cocer las castañas por al menos quince minutos.

source: A bear will not touch a dead body.
target: Un oso no tocará un cadáver.

source: A bear can climb a tree.
target: Un oso puede subirse a un árbol.

source: Bears also tend to sleep more during the day than at night, although in the summer, with twenty-four hours of light, this does not apply.
target: Los osos también suelen dormir más durante el día que durante la noche, aunque esto no se aplica durante el verano, con veinticuatro horas de luz.

source: How long does a bear sleep?
target: ¿Cuánto tiempo duerme un oso?

source: When bears sleep or lie down, their postures depend on whether they want to get rid of heat or conserve it.
target: Cuando un oso duerme o se relaja, su postura depende si quiere conservar el calor o si quiere librarse de él.

source: No one noticed the bear's appearance.
target: Nadie se dio cuenta de la aparición del oso.

source: Are my socks dry already?
target: ¿Mis calcetines ya están secos?

source: There is a hole in your sock.
target: Hay un agujero en tu calcetín.

source: Please put on your shoes.
target: Ponte los zapatos, por favor.

source: Put on your shoes.
target: Ponte tus zapatos.

source: Before buying shoes, you should try them on.
target: Antes de comprar zapatos, deberías probártelos.

source: Take off your shoes.

target: L'un de vous deux, elle ou toi, doit aller là-bas.

source: As you have insulted him, he is cross with you.
target: Comme vous l'avez insulté, il est fâché contre vous.

source: We thought it wrong that you should punish him.
target: Nous pensions qu'il était injuste que vous dussiez le punir.

source: It is no use your trying to persuade him.
target: Ça ne sert à rien que tu tentes de le persuader.

source: Does he know that you love him?
target: Sait-il que tu l’aimes ?

source: Imagine yourself to be in his place.
target: Mets-toi à sa place.

source: You did well not to follow his advice.
target: Tu as bien fait de ne pas suivre ses conseils.

source: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
target: C'était idiot de ta part d'accepter son offre.

source: Either you or he has to attend the meeting.
target: Soit toi, soit lui doit assister à la réunion.

source: I don't approve of your going out with him.
target: Je n'approuve pas que tu sortes avec lui.

source: Show me what you bought.
target: Montre-moi ce que tu as acheté.

source: How much is the car you are planning to buy?
target: Combien coûte la voiture que vous envisagez d'acheter ?

source: I saw you with a tall boy.
target: Je t'ai vu avec un garçon de grande taille.

source: He is no more foolish than you are.
target: Il n'est pas plus bête que tu ne l'es.

source: It is amazing that you won the prize.
target: C'est génial que tu aies remporté le prix.

source: It's a pity that you should leave Japan.
target: C'est dommage que tu quittes le Japon.

source: I'll take over your duties while you are away from Japan.
target: Je prendrai en charge vos responsabilités pendant que vous êtes loin du Japon.

source: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
target: Je vais le faire, que tu sois d'accord ou pas.

source: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
target: Je ne m'oppose pas à ce que tu ailles travailler à l'extérieur, mais qui s'occupera des enfants ?

source: I'm very happy you'll be visiting Tokyo next month.
target: Je suis très content que tu visites Tokyo le mois prochain.

source: You have good reason to be angry.
target: Vous avez une bonne raison d'être en colère.

source: It is difficult for you to climb to the mountaintop.
target: Tu as du mal à escalader jusqu'au sommet.

source: It's quite plain that you haven't been paying attention.
target: C'est très clair que tu as été inattentif.

source: It is a pity that you can't join us.
target: C'est dommage que vous ne puissiez pas venir avec nous.

source: You had better not wake me up when you come in.
target: Tu ferais mieux de ne pas me réveiller lorsque tu rentreras.

source: I sincerely hope that you will soon recover from your illness.
target: J'espère sincèrement que tu te remettras bientôt de ta maladie.

source: I hope that you will get well soon.
target: J'espère que vous allez vous rétablir bientôt.

source: I found the very thing you had been looking for.
target: J'ai trouvé exactement ce que tu cherchais.

source: I don't care whichever you choose.
target: Peu m'importe laquelle tu choisis.

source: You speak first; I will speak after.
target: Tu parles en premier; je parlerai ensuite.

source: I guess you are right.
target: Je suppose que tu as raison.

source: I am glad that you have succeeded.
target: Je suis heureuse que vous ayez réussi.

source: I'm glad to hear of your success.
target: Je suis heureux d'entendre parler de ton succès.

source: Tell me when you will call me.
target: Dis-moi quand tu m'appelleras !

source: I should be glad if you got the job.
target: Je devrais être heureux si tu as obtenu le boulot.

source: You may or may not win.
target: Tu peux gagner ou pas.

source: If it were not for your help, I might have failed.
target: N'eût été grâce à votre aide, j'aurais pu échouer.

source: Thanks to your help, I could understand the book quite well.
target: Grâce à ton aide, j'ai pu bien comprendre le livre.

source: Your o's look like a's.
target: Tes « o » ressemblent à des « a ».

source: He came after you left.
target: Il est venu après que tu fus parti.

source: I will wait till you have written the letter.
target: J'attendrai jusqu'à ce que vous écriviez la lettre.

source: It is strange that you should fail.
target: Il est étrange que tu n'aies pas réussi.

source: A time will come when you will regret your action.
target: Un jour viendra où vous regretterez votre action.

source: You may as well go yourself.
target: Tu peux aussi t'y rendre toi-même.

source: You should talk to the teacher yourself.
target: Tu devrais aller parler toi-même au professeur.

source: I love you more than you love me.
target: Je t'aime plus que tu ne m'aimes.

source: Either you or I must go in his place.
target: Vous ou moi devons y aller à sa place.

source: What's the reason that made you call me?
target: Quelle est la raison de votre appel ?

source: What is it that you want me to do?
target: Que veux-tu que je fasse ?

source: I can't thank you enough for what you did for me.
target: Je ne saurais vous remercier assez pour ce que vous avez fait pour moi.

source: I wish you could come with us.
target: J'aimerais que vous puissiez venir avec nous.

source: I'll look after your affairs when you are dead.
target: Je m'occuperai de tes affaires quand tu seras mort.

source: I don't have as much money as you think.
target: Je n'ai pas autant d'argent que tu le penses.

source: How much money did you spend in total?
target: Combien d'argent as-tu dépensé au total ?

source: Can you account for all the money you spent?
target: Pouvez-vous rendre compte de tout l'argent que vous avez dépensé ?

source: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
target: Avec votre approbation, j'aimerais lui proposer le poste.

source: It was wise of you to take your umbrella with you.
target: C'était judicieux de ta part de prendre un parapluie avec toi.

source: Show me the doll that you bought yesterday.
target: Montre-moi la poupée que tu as achetée hier.

source: Choose the color you like the best.
target: Choisis la couleur que tu préfères.

source: Your mother has made you what you are.
target: Votre mère a fait de vous ce que vous êtes.

source: It is necessary for you to go and encourage the girl.
target: Il faut que tu ailles encourager la fille.

source: It makes no difference whether you go or not.
target: Que tu partes ou pas est indifférent.

source: You don't need to go unless you want to.
target: Tu ne dois pas t'en aller, à moins que tu ne le veuilles.

source: If you don't go, I won't, either.
target: Si tu n'y vas pas, je n'irai pas moi non plus.

source: You don't have to go unless you want to.
target: Tu n'es pas obligé d'y aller, à moins que tu ne le veuilles.

source: I don't care as long as you are happy.
target: Je m'en fous, du moment que tu es heureux.

source: What you have said applies only to single women.
target: Ce que vous avez dit ne s'applique qu'aux femmes célibataires.

source: What you said surprised me.
target: Ce que vous avez dit m'a surpris.

source: I know you are rich.
target: Je sais que vous êtes riche.

source: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
target: Vous ne pouvez pas avoir faim. Vous venez juste de dîner.

source: I hope you'll never turn Communist.
target: J'espère que tu ne tourneras jamais communiste.

source: I will not allow you to be ill-treated.
target: Je ne permettrai pas que vous soyez maltraité.

source: I wish you could drop in at my house on your way home.
target: Je voudrais que tu puisses passer chez moi sur ton chemin.

source: I'll stay here till you get back.
target: Je reste ici jusqu'à ce que tu reviennes.

source: I will have finished the work before you return.
target: J'aurai terminé le travail avant que vous ne reveniez.

source: The money you give them will be put to good use.
target: L'argent que vous leur donnez sera consacré à un bon usage.

source: Thanks to your stupidity, we lost the game.
target: Grâce à votre stupidité, nous avons perdu la partie.

source: It's clear that you're wrong.
target: Il est évident que tu as tort.

source: You shouldn't have paid the bill.
target: Tu n'aurais pas dû payer l'addition.

source: It is important for you to learn a foreign language.
target: Il est important pour toi d'apprendre une langue étrangère.

source: I'm counting on you to join us.
target: Je compte sur toi pour te joindre à nous.

source: It is a pity that you cannot travel with us.
target: Il est dommage que vous ne puissiez voyager avec nous.

source: I'll come again when you are free.
target: Je reviendrai quand tu seras libre.

source: I haven't the faintest idea what you mean.
target: Je n'ai pas la moindre idée de ce que vous voulez dire.

source: I do not mind what you do.
target: Ce que vous faites ne me dérange pas.

source: Whatever you may say, I don't believe you.
target: Quoi que tu dises, je ne te crois pas.

source: I wish you were close to me.
target: Je regrette que vous ne soyez pas près de moi.

source: Your refusal to help complicated matters.
target: Ton refus d'aider a compliqué les choses.

source: I can no more speak French than you can speak English.
target: Je ne peux pas plus parler français que vous ne pouvez parler anglais.

source: What is the main purpose of your studying English?
target: Quel est l'objectif principal de votre apprentissage de l'anglais ?

source: If you could only speak English, you would be perfect.
target: Si vous pouviez seulement parler l'anglais, vous seriez parfait.

source: It's evident that you told a lie.
target: Il est évident que vous racontez un mensonge.

source: What is that thing in your right hand?
target: Quelle est cette chose dans ta main droite ?

source: It seems as if you are the first one here.
target: On dirait que vous êtes le premier ici.

source: You are to blame.
target: Vous êtes responsable.

source: It is because you are lazy that you cannot write your report.
target: C'est parce que tu es paresseux que tu ne peux pas écrire ton rapport.

source: I was about to leave when you telephoned.
target: J'allais partir quand tu as appelé.

source: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
target: J'attends de vos nouvelles.

source: You go first.
target: Je vous en prie.

source: I heard it from you.
target: Je l'ai appris de toi.

source: I didn't expect such a nice present from you.
target: Je ne m'attendais pas à un si gentil cadeau de ta part.

source: You can do whatever you want to.
target: Tu peux faire ce qui te chante.

source: In terms of the pay you will get, is this a good job?
target: En termes de rémunération, est-ce un bon poste ?

source: If you were to fall from that bridge, it would be almost impossible to rescue you.
target: Si vous veniez à tomber de ce pont, il serait impossible de vous sauver.

source: If you ask him again, he may change his mind.
target: Si tu lui redemandes, il se peut qu'il change d'avis.

source: Is it true that you are going to Paris?
target: Est-ce vrai que tu vas à Paris ?

source: I will see to it that you meet her at the party.
target: Je m'arrangerai pour que vous la rencontriez lors de la fête.

source: Say what you will; I won't change my mind.
target: Cause toujours, je ne changerai pas d'avis.

source: I marvel how you could agree to the proposal.
target: Je m'étonne de ce que vous puissiez accepter cette proposition.

source: I can imagine how you felt.
target: J'imagine ce que vous avez dû ressentir.

source: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
target: Essaie d'estimer combien tu dépenses en livres.

source: No matter where you may go, don't forget to write to me.
target: Où que vous puissiez aller, n'oubliez pas de m'écrire.

source: You should have nothing to complain about.
target: Tu ne devrais pas avoir de motif de te plaindre.

source: No wonder you could not open the door.
target: Pas étonnant que vous ne pouviez pas ouvrir la porte.

source: What is it that makes you think that way?
target: Qu'est-ce qui vous fait penser ainsi ?

source: I'm surprised at your behavior.
target: Je suis surpris de ton comportement.

source: It's strange you say that.
target: C'est bizarre que tu dises ça.

source: I can't abide hearing you cry so bitterly.
target: Je ne peux pas supporter de t'entendre pleurer si amèrement.

source: It's absurd of you to do that.
target: C'est absurde de ta part de faire ça.

source: It is a great pity that you don't know it.
target: Il est bien dommage que tu ne le saches pas.

source: It makes no difference to me whether you believe it or not.
target: Que tu le croies ou non ne me fait ni chaud ni froid.

source: It is right that you should write it.
target: Il est vrai que tu devrais l’écrire.

source: I'm glad you liked it.
target: Je suis heureux que tu l'aies aimé.

source: I wish you had not told the story to my mother.
target: J'aurais aimé que tu ne racontes pas cette histoire à ma mère.

source: You have no good reason for thinking as you do.
target: Vous n'avez pas de bonne raison pour penser comme vous le faites.

source: I cannot believe you did not see him then.
target: Je ne peux alors pas me figurer que vous ne l'ayez pas rencontré.

source: Ten to one you can pass the test.
target: Dix contre un que tu réussis ton test.

source: The time will come when you will be sorry for it.
target: Viendra le temps où tu le regretteras.

source: I'll do it, if you insist.
target: Je le ferai, si vous insistez.

source: By the time you got there, the sun had set.
target: Au moment où tu y es arrivé, le soleil s'était couché.

source: Since you say so.
target: Puisque tu le dis.

source: I don't blame you.
target: Je ne te le reproche pas.

source: There are a good many reasons why you shouldn't do it.
target: Il y a un bon nombre de raisons pour lesquelles vous ne devriez pas le faire.

source: I don't blame you for doing that.
target: Je ne vous reproche pas de le faire.

source: I'll do everything you tell me to do.
target: Je ferai tout ce que vous me dites de faire.

source: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
target: Ta conduite est absolument honteuse.

source: I didn't expect you to get here so soon.
target: Je ne t'attendais pas ici de si tôt.

source: It was too bad you couldn't come.
target: C'était dommage que tu ne pouvais pas venir.

source: It's a pity that you couldn't come.
target: C'est dommage que tu n'aies pas pu venir.

source: It is easy for you to solve this problem.
target: Il est facile pour toi de résoudre ce problème.

source: You wrote this book?
target: Tu as écrit ce livre ?

source: I didn't know that you were in this town.
target: Je ne savais pas que tu étais dans cette ville.

source: It is dangerous for you to swim in this river.
target: C'est dangereux pour toi de nager dans cette rivière.

source: Where was it that you found this key?
target: Où donc as-tu trouvé cette clé ?

source: I didn't expect you to turn up here.
target: Je ne comptais pas que tu te montrerais ici.

source: There is no need for you to stay here.
target: Tu n'es pas obligé de rester ici.

source: As long as you're here, I'll stay.
target: Tant que tu seras là, je resterai.

source: I had no notion that you were coming.
target: Je ne pensais pas que vous viendriez.

source: My life would be completely empty without you.
target: Ma vie serait complètement vide, sans toi.

source: You'll be missed by your friends.
target: Vous allez manquer à vos amis.

source: We shall all miss you when you go away.
target: Vous nous manquerez à tous quand vous partirez.

source: I miss you badly.
target: Tu me manques beaucoup.

source: How I miss you.
target: Comme tu me manques !

source: I miss you very much.
target: Vous me manquez beaucoup.

source: We all miss you very much.
target: Tu nous manques beaucoup à tous.

source: We will miss you badly.
target: Tu vas cruellement nous manquer.

source: Whenever you come, I'm ready.
target: Je serai prêt quel que soit le moment où tu viens.

source: Why is it that you are always late?
target: Comment se fait-il que tu sois toujours en retard ?

source: You may stay here as long as you like.
target: Tu peux rester ici aussi longtemps que tu veux.

source: You can talk until you're blue in the face, but you'll never convince me.
target: Tu peux raconter ce que tu veux, mais tu n'arriveras jamais à me convaincre.

source: Laugh as much as you like; I'll stick to my plan to the bitter end.
target: Ris comme tu veux, je m'accroche à mon plan jusqu'à la fin.

source: If only you had told me the whole story at that time!
target: Si seulement tu m'avais raconté toute l'histoire à l'époque !

source: It is impossible for you to jump two meters high.
target: Il est impossible que tu puisses sauter à deux mètres de hauteur.

source: Here is a letter for you.
target: Voici une lettre pour vous.

source: You, be quiet!
target: Toi, reste tranquille !

source: You've filled out.
target: Tu t'es remplumé.

source: What time will you leave?
target: Tu pars quand ?

source: You don't understand.
target: Tu ne comprends pas.

source: Repetition helps you remember something.
target: C'est la répétition qui t'aide à te souvenir de quelque chose.

source: A bear will not touch a dead body.
target: Un ours ne touchera pas un cadavre.

source: A bear can climb a tree.
target: Un ours peut grimper à un arbre.

source: The bear left no stone unturned in his search for fat bugs under the rocks.
target: L'ours n'omit de chercher dans aucun endroit alors qu'il cherchait des insectes juteux.

source: How long does a bear sleep?
target: Combien de temps un ours dort-il ?

source: No one noticed the bear's appearance.
target: Personne ne remarqua l'apparition de l'ours.

source: Stockings should be of the proper size.
target: Les bas devraient être de la bonne taille.

source: Are my socks dry already?
target: Mes chaussettes sont-elles déjà sèches ?

source: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
target: Mets tes chaussures et allons dîner.

source: Please put on your shoes.
target: Veuillez mettre vos chaussures.

source: Take off your shoes.
target: Enlève tes chaussures.

source: Please take off your shoes.
target: Enlève tes chaussures, s'il te plaît.

source: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
target: Veuillez retirer vos chaussures avant d'entrer dans la maison.

source: I bought a pair of shoes.
target: J'ai acheté une paire de chaussures.

source: Shoes are stiff when they are new.
target: Les chaussures sont raides quand elles sont neuves.

source: Shoes are sold in pairs.
target: Les chaussures se vendent par paires.

source: Where're the shoes?
target: Où sont les chaussures ?

source: Tie your shoelaces.
target: Attache tes lacets.

source: Gum got stuck to the bottom of my shoe.
target: Du chewing-gum s'est collé à ma semelle.

source: Brush off the dust from your shoes.
target: Enlève la poussière de tes chaussures.

source: I'd like some shoes.
target: J'aimerais des chaussures.

source: My shoes are worn out.
target: Mes chaussures sont usées.

source: The shoes are worn out.
target: Les chaussures sont usées.

source: Could we have a table in the corner?
target: Pourrions-nous avoir une table dans le coin ?

source: Don't leave it up to chance.
target: Ne le laisse pas au hasard.

source: I met her by accident.
target: Je l'ai rencontrée accidentellement.

source: By chance we saw him as he came out of the shop.
target: Par chance, on l'a vu en train de sortir du magasin.

source: What a coincidence!
target: Quelle coïncidence !

source: I just came up with the word.
target: Je viens juste de créer le mot.

source: I found the book by accident.
target: J'ai trouvé le livre par hasard.

source: I found that restaurant by accident.
target: J'ai trouvé ce restaurant par hasard.

source: I met her by chance.
target: Je l'ai rencontrée par hasard.

source: It happened that I saw my friend walking in the distance.
target: Il se trouve que j'ai vu mon ami marcher au loin.

source: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
target: Un nombre pair multiplié par un nombre impair donne un nombre pair. Un nombre impair multiplié par un nombre impair donne un nombre impair.

source: The sky looks angry.
target: Le ciel semble en colère.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it will be fine tomorrow.
target: À en juger d'après le ciel, il fera beau demain.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it is going to snow.
target: D'après l'aspect du ciel, il va neiger.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
target: À en juger par le ciel, il est possible qu'il pleuve cet après-midi.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it will clear up in the afternoon.
target: Au vu du ciel, le temps se dégagera dans l'après-midi.

source: Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
target: À en croire l'état du ciel, il est probable qu'il pleuve.

source: From the look of the sky, it may begin to snow tonight.
target: D'après l'aspect du ciel, il se peut qu'il se mette à neiger ce soir.

source: From the look of the sky I'm afraid the rain won't let up for a while.
target: Vu l'apparence du ciel, j'ai bien peur que la pluie ne s'arrête pas de sitôt.

source: Hunger is the best sauce.
target: La faim est le meilleur des cuisiniers.

source: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.
target: Il ne peut pas avoir faim ; il vient de déjeuner.

source: It is a shameful fact that, while there are lands where people suffer from hunger, within Japan there are many households and restaurants where much food is thrown away.
target: Il est honteux qu'en même temps qu'il existe des endroits où des personnes souffrent de la faim, à l'intérieur du Japon il y ait des maisons et des restaurants où beaucoup de nourriture est gaspillée.

source: Hungry and thirsty, we at last reached the inn.
target: Affamés et assoiffés, nous atteignîmes enfin l'auberge.

source: I must make up for lost time.
target: Je dois rattraper le temps perdu.

source: Fantasy is often the mother of art.
target: Le fantasme est souvent la mère de l'art.

source: Our house was robbed while we were away.
target: Notre maison a été cambriolée pendant que nous étions partis.

source: Are seats available?
target: Y a-t-il des places libres ?

source: Fill in the blanks.
target: Remplissez les blancs.

source: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
target: Remplissez les blancs par des mots appropriés.

source: You are hearing things.
target: Vous entendez des choses.

source: Where can I get a shuttle bus at the airport?
target: Où puis-je trouver une navette pour l'aéroport ?

source: I'll drive you to the airport.
target: Je vais vous conduire à l'aéroport.

source: I arranged for a car to meet you at the airport.
target: J'ai prévu pour toi une voiture qui vient te chercher à l'aéroport.

source: May I accompany you to the airport?
target: Puis-je vous accompagner à l'aéroport ?

source: How much will it cost to get to the airport?
target: Combien cela coûtera-t-il d'aller à l'aéroport ?

source: How far is it to the airport?
target: À quelle distance est l'aéroport ?

source: How long do you think it will take to go to the airport?
target: Combien de temps pensez-vous que cela prendra pour aller à l'aéroport ?

source: I'll accompany you to the airport.
target: Je vous accompagnerai à l'aéroport.

source: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
target: Veuillez m'indiquer comment me rendre à l'aéroport.

source: I went to the airport by taxi.
target: Je me suis rendu à l'aéroport en taxi.

source: I could've met you at the airport.
target: J'aurais pu vous rencontrer à l'aéroport.

source: The airport was closed because of the fog.
target: L'aéroport était fermé à cause du brouillard.

source: Where do I get an airport bus?
target: Où est-ce que je peux trouver une bus pour l'aéroport ?

source: I prefer a hotel by the airport.
target: Je préfère un hôtel proche de l'aéroport.

source: Arriving at the airport, I saw the plane taking off.
target: En arrivant à l'aéroport, je vis l'avion décoller.

source: I'll phone you as soon as I get to the airport.
target: Je t'appellerai dès que j'arrive à l'aéroport.

source: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.
target: Je dois aller à l'aéroport pour rencontrer ma famille.

source: What time should I go to the airport?
target: À quelle heure devrais-je me rendre à l'aéroport ?

source: Upon arriving at the airport, he made a phone call to his wife.
target: À son arrivée à l'aéroport, il a téléphoné à sa femme.

source: The long wait at the airport was tedious.
target: La longue attente à l'aéroport était ennuyeuse.

source: A time bomb went off in the airport killing thirteen people.
target: Une bombe à retardement a explosé dans l’aéroport tuant treize personnes.

source: They shook hands when they met at the airport.
target: Ils se serrèrent la main lorsqu'ils se rencontrèrent à l'aéroport.

source: How long does it take to your office from the airport?
target: Combien de temps cela prend-il depuis l'aéroport jusqu'à votre bureau ?
